parent_results_seen: Parent PR261 has 13/48 robust new-site majority outcomes under amp=0 eps=0, and zero robust under amp=.35 eps=.35; its synthetic true-q oracle still had 20/48 positive comparisons. This new route is post-exposure methodological work, not blind discovery.
science_question: With the SAME number of independently gold-standard-labeled true animal passage opportunities, what temporal pooling length for per-camera per-season-branch per-civil-clock-block detector q best balances simultaneous 97.5% source calibration precision and legitimate within-branch date-to-date q drift?
q_generator: Reuse parent PR261 same physical station-by-branch q from PR260 heterogeneous branch-shifted world (index 1), same 32 physical site type assignment and parent true_daily_q cosine formula. For amp=0 reuse original parent animal-event counts and fitted training predictions. For amp=.35 reuse parent PR261 source-free daily-distorted event counts with its original frozen new animal RNG.

uniform_reference_opportunities.reference_rng: NumPy SeedSequence([2026101029, q_world_index, budget_index, block_length, 999]) independently generates all source calibration successes; never depends on animal detections
uniform_reference_opportunities.method: At each site×branch×clock 4h group, partition its ORIGINAL 41 date-pair indices into successive NONOVERLAPPING chronological groups of maximum length m, with final group possibly shorter. For each of n_day*group_length independent gold-standard passage references within one group, independently sample source date UNIFORMLY among its group dates, then trigger Bernoulli(q_true_site_branch_date_clock). Therefore each triggered source reference event is exactly iid Bernoulli(mean(q_true across group dates)); successes are genuinely Binomial(n_day*group_length, group_mean_q) even if daily camera q is heterogeneous.
uniform_reference_opportunities.reference_total_identity: T=16 heldout physical sites ×2 photoperiod branches×6 original civil 4h camera q bins×41 original dates×n_day; identical across all four partition lengths within a given budget.

statistical_procedure.q_group_confidence: Two-sided exact Clopper–Pearson intervals with Bonferroni over ALL 192×groups_per_branch independent source q means. For group length m, use independent group reference count n_day*actual_group_length, not individual day n.
statistical_procedure.external_smoothness: If genuine independently certified absolute adjacent-day |q_site,branch,j+1,block - q_site,branch,j,block|<=L, and μ_g is group average over d consecutive days, then each group's true day q is within L*(d-1)/2 of μ_g (in absolute q probability), by the maximum average temporal distance bound. This bound is deterministic and must NOT be inferred or selected by reading animal detections or inspecting synthetic confidence coverage.
statistical_procedure.q_daily_interval: day q lower=max(0, CP_lower_group - L*(actual_group_length-1)/2); upper=min(1, CP_upper_group+L*(actual_group_length-1)/2); if any q interval lower zero return HOLD rather than insert pseudocount.
statistical_procedure.source_reference_correct_but_drift_trans: Each pooled group q SOURCE CP interval has finite-sample simultaneous reference-group mean coverage, but never claim it also covers each individual day unless the independent external Lipschitz cap is valid.
statistical_procedure.score_envelope: For the fixed training-estimated five models, use SAME detected civil-bin responses and same unknown physical q in each model normalizer. For each original site×day, exactly bound the positive ratio Z_A/Z_B for six original civil 4h groups, then sum across all 82 original days for a conservative OUTER lower site logscore gap (q links over time ignored in optimization). Never call it sharp across all 82 days.
statistical_procedure.site_majority: 16 independent heldout sites with strict-positive q-robust lower A−B score contribute to K. Exact nonrandomized Binomial(16,.5) one-sided upper tail at .00625 per four precommitted pairs; >=14 robust-positive independent physical sites required.
statistical_procedure.coverage_oracle_gating: Synthetic oracle truth whether CP source box covers group q is AUDIT ONLY; not used to decide if test runs, HOLD, q-group pooling, α, or site-majority certification.

synthetic_proof_gates: Every 16×2×6×41×n_day total source reference opportunity count EXACT for all 4 time pooling lengths
Joint CP interval implemented on actual mean of ORIGINAL independent-date sample mixture, not invalid fixed-count heterogeneous Bernoulli pooling
Daily q drift from source-free amp=.35 has maximum ABSOLUTE adjacent-day variation <=0.03; amp=0 has <=0
On simultaneous group mean CP coverage event, expanded per-date bounds contain ALL original 16×82×6 true q, except where zero q lower triggers HOLD

Within a fixed q truth/budget/animal observed event table, q lower site score is nondecreasing in source precision only if confidence boxes are nested; no arbitrary monotonicity across differently randomized source reference samples claimed
Reference q group CP oracle coverage is NEVER used as an operational gate
Source q 41-day reference date mean does not automatically identify actual each-day q if within-branch drift is present
All first 96 paired cases×4 methods report counts of certified 16-site majority, not-certified and zero lower CP HOLD
At L=0 in stationary q world every method's q-group temporal scope is source-admissible; at L=.03 in cosine world group CP bounds must be expanded by L*(d-1)/2
No new biological inference or real EcoBank source eligibility claimed.
